# Hidden Roof

> Hidden Roof is a free multiplayer graffiti game in your browser — paint ink-drawn rooftops alone or with your friends.

A first-person game: you climb onto the rooftops of a city drawn in ink, and the only color in it is the paint you bring.

There are no enemies and no goals: find your tools, paint whatever you like, scrub it off, paint again. Play alone, or bring friends into a multiplayer session and paint the same roof together.

- Play: https://roof.hidden.haus/
- Creator: GeoGeorgeous
- Free, in the browser: no account, no install.
- The spray can paints like a brush: continuous strokes, layered opacity, caps from skinny to wide soft, and paint that drips; distance and hand speed change the line as with a real can.
- Needs a desktop browser with WebGL2, a keyboard and a mouse. Phones and tablets are not supported.
- Solo, or multiplayer: pick a session from the server list, a public one (up to 40 players) or a private one by its code (up to 4).
- Inspired by Bombing!!, Marc Ecko's Getting Up and Daisuke Tajima's Beyond the Lines.
